title: EMR Serverless applications STARTED with pre-initialized capacity and no auto-stop
why: Pre-initialized workers bill while the application is started, even with no jobs.
detect: emr-serverless:ListApplications state=STARTED; GetApplication initialCapacity non-empty, autoStopConfiguration.enabled=false or idleTimeoutMinutes large; ListJobRuns with no recent runs
false_positive_traps: Latency-sensitive interactive apps.

title: MWAA environments with no DAG runs
why: An environment bills hourly for its class (scheduler, web server, minimum workers) even when no DAG runs, often hundreds of dollars a month.
detect: mwaa:ListEnvironments then GetEnvironment (EnvironmentClass, MinWorkers); CloudWatch AmazonMWAA DAG-run and task metrics = 0 over 30 days
false_positive_traps: Monthly or quarterly DAGs. Use a window longer than the schedule.

title: Glue dev endpoints, idle interactive sessions and over-frequent crawlers
why: Dev endpoints bill per DPU-hour while provisioned. Crawlers on hourly schedules over unchanged data and idle sessions add steady cost.
detect: glue:GetDevEndpoints (any present); glue:ListSessions Status=READY with old LastModifiedOn; glue:GetCrawlers Schedule frequency <= hourly with LastCrawl showing no schema or partition changes
false_positive_traps: Crawlers feeding partitions for hourly ingest.

title: Athena workgroups with no per-query scan limit, and idle capacity reservations
why: One unpartitioned query can scan terabytes billed per TB, and capacity reservations bill per DPU-hour even when idle.
detect: athena:ListWorkGroups then GetWorkGroup Configuration.BytesScannedCutoffPerQuery unset, EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration=false; athena:ListCapacityReservations Status=ACTIVE with low use; the result bucket has no lifecycle
false_positive_traps: Analytics workgroups that need large scans. Set a high limit rather than none.

title: MSK broker disks near full without storage auto-scaling, or MSK Connect connectors FAILED
why: A full broker disk stops writes for the partitions on it. A failed connector silently stops data movement.
detect: CloudWatch AWS/Kafka KafkaDataLogsDiskUsed > 85% per broker; application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingPolicies ServiceNamespace=kafka missing; kafkaconnect:ListConnectors connectorState=FAILED
false_positive_traps: Tiered-storage clusters where local disk usage behaves differently.

title: IoT device or CA certificates expiring, and devices using the legacy VeriSign endpoint
why: Expired device or CA certificates disconnect fleets. AWS has deprecated the Symantec/VeriSign certificates behind the iot:Data endpoint, and MQTT5 and dual-stack need ATS.
detect: iot:ListCertificates then DescribeCertificate validity.notAfter and status; iot:ListCACertificates then DescribeCACertificate validity; iot:DescribeDomainConfiguration server certificate status; legacy-endpoint use is visible only from device configs (no API, unverified)
false_positive_traps: Inactive or revoked certificates of retired devices.
api_cost_note: Free. Large fleets mean heavy pagination.

title: MediaLive channels RUNNING with no input signal, and active MediaConnect flows with no source
why: Running channels bill as long as they run even with no content. Push inputs bill even while idle, and AWS has no built-in auto-stop.
detect: medialive:ListChannels State=RUNNING; CloudWatch MediaLive input loss or InputVideoFrameRate=0 over hours; medialive:ListInputs push inputs unattached; mediaconnect:ListFlows Status=ACTIVE with source bitrate 0
false_positive_traps: 24/7 standby channels for scheduled events.

title: Leased phone numbers, SES dedicated IPs and Connect DIDs with no traffic
why: SES standard dedicated IPs cost $24.95 per IP per month. Origination numbers and Connect numbers have monthly lease fees whether used or not.
detect: sesv2:GetDedicatedIps with no sends (sesv2 dedicated IP pool metrics); pinpoint-sms-voice-v2:DescribePhoneNumbers and DescribeSenderIds with no sends in CloudWatch; connect:ListPhoneNumbersV2 numbers not associated with a contact flow
false_positive_traps: Warm-up IPs, DR numbers.

service: Elastic Disaster Recovery / Application Migration Service
title: DRS source servers stalled or orphaned, and MGN replication left running after cutover
why: DRS bills per source server per hour and keeps staging EBS and replication EC2. A stalled server means the DR copy is stale without anyone noticing.
detect: drs:DescribeSourceServers dataReplicationInfo.dataReplicationState in (STALLED, DISCONNECTED) or lastSeenByService old; mgn:DescribeSourceServers lifeCycle.state=CUTOVER and isArchived=false; EC2 and EBS tagged AWSElasticDisasterRecoveryManaged or AWSApplicationMigrationServiceManaged (tag names unverified)
false_positive_traps: Source servers in planned maintenance.

title: CloudHSM clusters with HSMs and no consumers
why: Each HSM bills hourly (more than $1/hr, exact rate unverified), and clusters often outlive a proof of concept.
detect: cloudhsmv2:DescribeClusters Hsms count>0; kms:DescribeCustomKeyStores with no CloudHSM store linked; CloudTrail or HSM audit logs show no activity
false_positive_traps: Applications using PKCS#11 directly, where KMS shows no link.

title: RAM resource shares to accounts outside the organization
why: Subnets, TGWs, Resolver rules or license configs shared with external accounts persist after partnerships end.
detect: ram:GetResourceShares resourceOwner=SELF allowExternalPrincipals=true; ram:ListPrincipals; compare with organizations:ListAccounts
false_positive_traps: Intentional vendor shares. Require an owner tag.

title: Control Tower landing zone drifted or behind the latest version
why: Drift breaks guardrail guarantees and account vending, and old landing zone versions lose support for new controls.
detect: controltower:ListLandingZones then GetLandingZone (driftStatus, version, latestAvailableVersion); controltower:ListEnabledControls driftStatusSummary
false_positive_traps: Accounts not enrolled in Control Tower at all.

title: Steady compute and database usage not covered by Savings Plans or RIs
why: Steady On-Demand usage costs about 20-70% more than a commitment. The existing checks cover only expiry and utilization, not coverage.
detect: ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage and ce:GetReservationCoverage below 70% for 3 or more months of stable usage; ce:GetSavingsPlansPurchaseRecommendation EstimatedMonthlySavingsAmount
false_positive_traps: Workloads planned for shutdown or migration, and Spot-heavy fleets.

title: Over-provisioned EC2, ASG, EBS, Lambda, ECS and RDS, or Compute Optimizer not enabled
why: Rightsizing is usually the largest single saving after zombie cleanup, and without opt-in there is no data at all.
detect: compute-optimizer:GetEnrollmentStatus (status != Active is itself a finding); GetEC2InstanceRecommendations finding=OVER_PROVISIONED; GetEBSVolumeRecommendations; GetLambdaFunctionRecommendations; cost-optimization-hub:ListRecommendations ordered by estimatedMonthlySavings
false_positive_traps: Memory metrics need the CloudWatch agent, so without it EC2 memory looks idle.
api_cost_note: Free. Enhanced infrastructure metrics are paid.

title: Marketplace SaaS and AMI contracts auto-renewing or unused
why: Marketplace contracts can auto-renew for a full term, and AMI subscriptions keep billing hourly software fees on forgotten instances.
detect: marketplace-agreement:SearchAgreements (party=Proposee, status ACTIVE, endTime soon); ce:GetCostAndUsage BILLING_ENTITY='AWS Marketplace' grouped by SERVICE; EC2 instances with Marketplace ProductCodes
false_positive_traps: Org-level purchases visible only from the payer account.
api_cost_note: CE API costs $0.01 per request. Agreement API availability is unverified.

title: Account on the credit-based Free plan nearing its 6-month end or credit exhaustion
why: For accounts created after 2025-07-15, the Free plan ends after 6 months or when credits run out. The account is then closed unless upgraded, and resources become inaccessible.
detect: freetier:GetAccountPlanState (API name unverified) or the Billing console plan; ce:GetCostAndUsage RECORD_TYPE=Credit for remaining credits; account creation date
false_positive_traps: Legacy 12-month free tier accounts created before 2025-07-15 follow different rules.

title: Paid duplicate management-event trails, broad data events or oversized CloudTrail Lake stores
why: Only the first copy of management events is free. Extra trails, all-bucket S3 or Lambda data events and Lake ingestion add silent per-event cost.
detect: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails plus GetEventSelectors and GetAdvancedEventSelectors (more than one trail with management events in the same Region; data selectors on all S3 objects); cloudtrail:ListEventDataStores (retention, ingestion); CE usage types *-DataEventsRecorded, *-PaidEventsRecorded
false_positive_traps: An org trail plus a separate security-account trail kept on purpose.

title: Config recording every resource type continuously in high-churn environments
why: Configuration items are billed per change. EKS or autoscaling churn on ENIs, instances and volumes can make Config a top-10 line item, and daily periodic recording fixes it.
detect: config:DescribeConfigurationRecorders recordingGroup.allSupported=true and recordingMode.recordingFrequency=CONTINUOUS; CE usage type *ConfigurationItemRecorded trend; top resource types from config:GetDiscoveredResourceCounts
false_positive_traps: Compliance regimes that need continuous recording for specific types. Override only the high-churn ones.

title: High CloudWatch log ingestion, custom metrics, metric streams or third-party GetMetricData polling
why: Log ingestion per GB, high-cardinality custom metrics and monitoring tools polling GetMetricData often cost more than the workloads they watch. The retention check doesn't catch ingestion.
detect: CE usage types *DataProcessing-Bytes, *MetricMonitorUsage, *GMD-Metrics, *MetricStreamUsage; logs:DescribeLogGroups plus CloudWatch IncomingBytes by log group (top-N); cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams; ec2 detailed monitoring enabled (DescribeInstances Monitoring.State=enabled)
false_positive_traps: Security logs that must be ingested. Suggest the Infrequent Access log class instead of dropping them.
api_cost_note: CE API costs $0.01 per request. GetMetricData is billed per metric.

title: State Manager associations, automations and maintenance-window tasks failing
why: Patching, agent installs and compliance baselines silently stop being applied while dashboards still show the association as configured.
detect: ssm:ListAssociations then DescribeAssociationExecutions Status=Failed; ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions ExecutionStatus=Failed or TimedOut; ssm:DescribeMaintenanceWindowExecutions Status=FAILED
false_positive_traps: Targets that were terminated mid-run.

title: Batch compute environments INVALID or DISABLED, and jobs stuck RUNNABLE
why: An INVALID environment (deleted role, subnet, launch template or AMI) leaves jobs RUNNABLE forever without reporting an error.
detect: batch:DescribeComputeEnvironments status=INVALID (statusReason) or state=DISABLED; batch:ListJobs jobStatus=RUNNABLE with createdAt older than 1 hour
false_positive_traps: Queues waiting for Spot capacity on purpose.

title: GameLift fleets with active instances and no game sessions
why: Fleet instances bill like EC2 whether players connect or not, and test fleets are often left at minimum size 1 or more.
detect: gamelift:DescribeFleetCapacity InstanceCounts.ACTIVE>0; CloudWatch ActiveGameSessions and CurrentPlayerSessions = 0 over 14 days
false_positive_traps: Pre-launch load-test fleets.

title: Traffic mirror sessions left active
why: Billed per ENI-hour of mirroring plus the cost of the target appliance, and usually set up for a one-off investigation.
detect: ec2:DescribeTrafficMirrorSessions; ec2:DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets pointing at deleted NLBs or ENIs
false_positive_traps: Permanent IDS deployments.

title: Support cases waiting on customer action
why: AWS-opened cases (exposed keys, abuse, limit requests) auto-resolve or escalate when nobody answers, and they often carry deadlines.
detect: support:DescribeCases includeResolvedCases=false, filter status=pending-customer-action; flag cases opened by AWS
false_positive_traps: Support API access depends on the support plan, which changes after the 2027-01-01 plan discontinuation.
